title: Credit Notes, Dispute Windows, Service Credits and Volume Rebates
content:
A credit note is raised against the invoice line it corrects and never as a free-standing amount, so every credit points back to what it reverses. A credit note is raised only while the programme record stands at active, suspended or expired.

The programme record of the Corporate Travel Programmes is the authority for that standing, and is read on the programme the credited line belongs to before the credit is raised.

## Correcting a line on dispute

A billing line is corrected on dispute only when frozen time is not after the moment the invoice carrying the disputed line was issued to the company plus the dispute window of the programme tier held. The dispute window is counted in whole calendar days from the day after the invoice date, weekends and public holidays included, and a dispute raised exactly on the closing day is still in time.

The anchor is the moment the invoice carrying the disputed line was issued, taken from the billing record of that line and correlated by the invoice the line was billed under. The date on which the company says the invoice reached it does not move that anchor.

| Day on which the dispute is raised | Whether the line is corrected on dispute |
| --- | --- |
| The day after the invoice date, the first of the counted days | In time |
| Any counted day before the closing day | In time |
| The closing day of the tier's window | In time |
| The day after the closing day | Out of time |

## Service credit against a missed response target

Where the service desk misses the tier's response target, the tier's service credit is applied to the following period's subscription, and a tier with no service credit gives none.

## The volume rebate

The volume rebate accrues on booking value above the tier's threshold in the contract year, at the tier's rebate percentage, and is credited once after the contract year closes rather than month by month. The contract year measured is the current one, running from the contract start date, and the booking value measured over it is the total of the amounts of the booking transaction fee lines on the same programme.

## What a credit does not become

A credit note never becomes a payment: it is applied against what the company owes, and a balance in the company's favour at closure is settled only after every open invoice has been cleared.

## What the record holds

A credit line carries the billing line it credits, whether the credit is a rebate, a service credit or a billing correction, the first and last dates of the period credited, the currency it was issued in and the invoice it was applied to.
